newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AEGON SAYS EXPECTS 15 PCT RISE IN 1997 NET.
newsitem.headline: AEGON SAYS EXPECTS 15 PCT RISE IN 1997 NET.

text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon NV said on Thursday it expected 1997 net profit and earnings per share to be 15 percent higher than in 1996.
"Aegon has upgraded its earnings forecast for 1997," Aegon said in a statement.

"Barring unforeseen circumstances...and not taking into account the impact of the acquisition of Providian (Corp), we expect an increase in 1997 net profit and earnings per share in guilders of some 15 percent," Aegon said.
Aegon said that, on top of that, the planned acquisition of the insurance activities of Providian Corporation would have a positive impact on earnings per share.
In March of this year, Aegon said it expected 1997 earnings per share to be 10 to 12 percent higher than 1996's, excluding the planned acquisition of Providian.
Aegon signed a $3.5 billion deal with Providian Corp in December of last year to take over Providian's insurance activities.
Aegon said in March it expected the deal, which is subject to -- among others -- Federal government approval, to be finalised in June or July.
